column1: # Does a location's dialogue table load on scene *entry* rather than on save
# restore? Every earlier Talk capture reached its NPC by Journey Onward from a
# save written inside the location, and the stock game refused every one. This
# seeds the party on the Britannia overworld at the hut at (153,91) and walks
# in through the door, so the entry path runs, then walks seventeen steps to
# the hut's only NPC - dialog-id 12, an ordinary `DWELLING.TLK` speaker - and
# talks. One NPC on the floor, so no schedule ambiguity about the target.
# Route from the engine's own `talk_gate_probe` breadth-first search. Pair with
# `dwelling-talk-after-restore`, which reaches the same NPC from a seeded save.

column4: Entered the hut through the door
Look east at the hut's NPC
Talk east after entering through the door
